description: Price & sales-rank history + stats for an Amazon ASIN — the historical low/high/avg, current Amazon/New/Used/Buy-Box prices, sales rank, and est. monthly units sold. Example: keepa_product({ asin: "B08N5WRWNW", domain: 1, _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Keepa API key (64-char hex; subscribe at keepa.com)

stats_days.description: Compute stats over the last N days (default 90).
